messages:
Hana: Quick note  were hosting a Saturday campus tour at 09:30 (25 people). Group will arrive together, a few parents with kids. Can we arrange volunteer guide badges, a stroller parking area, and a trolley for an evening equipment drop?
frontdesk-bot: New event pre-register: Weekend Tour  25 guests ETA 09:30. Volunteer badge color: orange. Reply 'ok' to confirm arrangements.
Scout: Ill be the volunteer guide. Need 3 orange volunteer lanyards + one lead badge. Also request a low table near foyer for sign-in and a cart for folding chairs.
Marcus: We have a folding-trolley in storage that can be staged at the side entrance at 09:10. Stroller parking: west alcove works and we can rope it off.
Facilities: Confirmed trolley staged 09:10 at side entrance. West alcove roped for stroller parking. Will leave cones and a small "stroller parking" sign.
Hana: Thanks. Also a vendor is dropping a lamp crate tonight at 19:00 for the demo area. It's medium-sized and marked "deliver to staging - do not open". Can we keep it out of the foyer until morning?
postmaster-bot: Package inbound: "Lamp crate" ETA 19:00. Current storage: Nighthold shelf B4. Delivery note: do not leave in lobby.
Marcus: I can move the crate to Storage Locker 3 after it arrives and lock it there. Someone from Ops will pick it up tomorrow morning.
Scout: For sign-in, please print a simple name list and hand volunteers stickers that say 'Tour Guide'. Also add a short note: "Please escort guests at all times".
frontdesk-bot: Front desk check-in checklist:
```
1) Ask group lead for reservation name
2) Print orange volunteer lanyards and lead badge
3) Hand out visitor stickers for parents/children
4) Direct strollers to west alcove (roped)
5) Escort groups to lobby -> demo hall; keep areas clear
```
Hana: Appreciate it. Marcus, ping me when the crate is moved so I can update the event page.
Marcus: Will do. Arriving tonight at ~19:10 to move crate to Locker 3.
Facilities: Leaving extra folding chairs and a small umbrella stand near the foyer, just in case.
Hana: Great, thanks everyone  will post a short update once everything is set.
